substeps.caption: The stream camera as built: a Raspberry Pi 5 with its Active Cooler, a Raspberry Pi HQ Camera with the 16 mm C-mount lens, and a Camera Module 3 Wide, on a printed head. The Wide sits on a nose level with the lens's front, so the 39 mm lens stays out of its 102-degree picture.
Height: the block slides up the post's T-slot and locks on two M5 drop-in T-nuts, as robot-arms' camera fixtures do.
Pan: the yoke turns on an M6 bolt through the block's arm, 40 degrees each way.
Tilt: the head turns between the yoke's arms on two thumb knobs, from level to 65 degrees down, where the lens's front reaches the yoke. Tilted down, the head stands 48 mm at most over its axis.
Aimed: down and to one side at an instrument's working face. The Wide sees 102 x 67 degrees, the HQ with the 16 mm lens 22 x 17: the detail. One PoE lead carries power and the stream.
